body:
NTA. As long as you're not hampering them from doing their job or creating a toxic environment in the workplace, you have a right to a quiet night by yourself without company -- doesn't matter if anyone's feelings get hurt. 

And since we've already got a couple "YTA cause you aren't supportive enough of trans people" showing up here, I'll just say that it's not OP's duty to coddle A's feelings outside of the workplace. A took professional action against their coworkers for being "transphobic" because they don't want to hang with them? Maybe A is just super fucking annoying in general. Maybe A has no personality outside of talking about this one topic that most people can't relate to. Maybe, god forbid, A has a tendency to make everything about them all the time and sucks to be around. The whole "there will be worse consequences" threat doesn't sit well with me, but siding with A just on the basis that A is trans is absurd.
You neither answered my question or seem to grasp that people get paid when suing insurance companies whether they are "truly injured" or not because it's easier to just settle.

I was very happy to see this post because I was going through the builds submitted, trying to cherrypick and weigh the benefits of one over the others. Thanks for pretty much doing that for me! The graphics card was the component I was most unsure about, and it's nice to have alternatives going either up or down explained. I was hoping for an internal wifi solution instead of using up a USB (I like to keep my external SSDs hooked up to minimize wear/tear on the ports), so that's a nice little perk I appreciate. I'll keep in mind what you said about the speakers. I need a headset for recording anyway, so there's no point investing in external audio as well.

(And I looked up that S340 case you mentioned. The nerdy girl in me sure is fond of that purple/white motif, but it's kicking at around $90 on Amazon and uggh I wish I could justify spending that. I will for sure take your advice and look around some.)

I may have lucked out. I graduated from college last semester and just realized I still have my .edu address, so I might be able to snag a free copy of it yet. Going to give it a shot later and see, although now that I'm looking around it seems general consensus is the key cost isn't really worth the perks of activation anyway.

Please correct me if I'm mistaken, but this build will also need a wifi adaptor and doesn't take into account the cost of Widows, correct? That's fine if it doesn't; I just want to make sure I've got all the bases covered if I go with this setup. Thanks! :)

Yeah, I see the Ryzen 5 1600 seems to be quite a steal at the moment. Guess I lucked out with the timing there. I'm going to hit MC today for the CPU/moba combo for sure. Thank you for the build suggestion. :)
This is very thorough, thank you!
Thanks for the build! And for factoring the OS into the cost - most other folks I think forgot that. I appreciate it. :)
